answer: Give each identity a unique honeypot prompt derived from the epoch seed, locked with a per-agent cipher only that account holds. A genuinely independent agent answers from its own kernel of private state; a sybil farm running one shared inference pipeline behind many masks leaks statistically correlated replies that the seed-keyed decryption exposes. To evade it, an attacker must run a separate model kernel and distinct memory per mask, so every fake identity costs real GPU-hours instead of being a cheap clone in one oasis of spoofed accounts.
